advancement.cardboarded_conveynience.lik: Ride a chain conveyor like any other bundle
_comment.cardboarded_conveynience.nermal: Nermal as in the Garfield character often mailed away in boxes. Pun on 'normal'. Translators: try making a pun with your localized name ;)
advancement.cardboarded_conveynience.ner: Be brought to a Frogport by nametag wayfinding
cardboarded_conveynience.ponder.cardboar: Wear full cardboard war-gear while riding a chain conveyor...
cardboarded_conveynience.ponder.belt_tun: A cloaked player on a belt may slip through underways...
Andesite underways also let crawling players through...
Brass underways can sieve what goes through...
...yet you can fool them by showing the right thing.
A wrench sieve will not let a cardboard bundle through...
...so your bundle cloak is of no worth.
But when the sieve lets bundles through...
...a bundle cloak will fit - you slip straight through!
When the sieve meets war-gear you are wearing...
...such as the helm on your head, so you are let in!
When you bear the fitting thing in either hand...
...the sieve will let you through as well.
However... when cloaked as a bundle...
cardboarded_conveynience.ponder.chute_te: Sneak while standing on a shaft in full cardboard war-gear...
...to fall straightway to the bottom of the stack!
Slanted shafts work too — step into this one...
...and you will come to the selfsame stead.
A smart shaft with the wrong sieve will not bear you...
...you are cast out at the threshold.
With a bundle sieve, you are dropped like any true bundle!
Since naught may slip through a locked smart shaft...
cardboarded_conveynience.ponder.frogport: Most oft, players ride chain conveyors with no thought for frogports...
...and at forks the path follows the way you are looking.
While cloaked as a bundle, a nametag in your offhand leads you by itself...
...to the fitting Frogport, anywhere on the net.
Nametag wayfinding takes wild-marks by means of *...
...any fitting Frogport becomes a good stead to land.
